prompt: Repair background-fetch lifecycle edge cases in LRUCache. Synchronous non-Promise fetchMethod results must fulfill. Internal fetch Promise placeholders must never be emitted through onInsert. Resolving a background fetch must not abort its own signal; distinguish replacing an in-flight fetch from resolving it. Classify resulting insert/update/replace status and callbacks relative to the actual stale value; unchanged stale values must not be disposed. Evicting an in-flight fetch must abort it and dispose its stale value exactly once through both disposal callbacks, preserving cache membership when its late result arrives. Preserve ordinary set/get/delete, async fetch sharing, TTL and size accounting. Coordinate the fetch completion, set replacement and eviction paths. Visible tests include limited reproductions, hidden tests are separate.
